name: Ram (son of Hezron)
title: Ancestor of David
summary: Ram was the son of Hezron and father of Amminadab in the tribe of Judah. He is a central link in the lineage from Judah to King David and further to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Link in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ram, son of Hezron, was father of Amminadab in the lineage from Judah to David.
